# 풀다

풀다 is a Korean digital project studio that turns complex business, brand, content, and workflow problems into clear web experiences and operational systems.

The official website is built as a static Astro site. It presents 풀다's positioning, selected project case studies, working philosophy, contact route, and operations portal policy.

## Primary Pages

- [Home](https://puldaunion.com/)
- [풀다 소개](https://puldaunion.com/about/)
- [Projects](https://puldaunion.com/project/)
- [Stories](https://puldaunion.com/story/)
- [Contact](https://puldaunion.com/contact/)

## Representative Case Studies

- [A4U Platform](https://puldaunion.com/project/a4u-platform/)
- [풀다 공식 웹사이트 리뉴얼](https://puldaunion.com/project/pulda-official-website-renewal/)
- [Eunjo Imweb Homepage](https://puldaunion.com/project/eunjo-imweb-homepage/)

## Editorial Notes

- 풀다 writes in Korean, with some English interface labels in dark mode.
- The site emphasizes first-hand project experience, planning judgment, web production, AI-assisted execution, automation, and lean project leadership.
- The current visual identity uses aged hanji, deep Taegeuk blue, old Taegeuk red, brush-like typography, and a light/dark dual identity.
